name: pensieve-dashboard-plugin
description: A local dashboard plugin for structured LLM memory visibility and lightweight governance.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and govern structured LLM memory from a local sidebar surface.
interface.longDescription: Pensieve Dashboard is a local plugin surface for observing structured LLM memory, tracking which memories stay prominent, and applying lightweight governance actions such as pin, soften, hide, and restore.
defaultPrompt: Open Pensieve and show what the system currently remembers most.
Inspect the local memory dashboard and highlight high-risk traces.
Review the current memory field and soften anything too persistent.
